instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Music rights and publishing company managing a catalog of 5,000 songs across 200 songwriters and composers. Handling royalty collection, sync licensing for TV/film/advertising, and copyright enforcement. Seeking to implement automated royalty tracking from streaming platforms and AI-assisted music similarity detection for infringement monitoring. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating 5 business units into 3 and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 7 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Royalty & Infringement Monitoring Platform Pilot
opportunities.rationale: The strategic goal of implementing AI-assisted music similarity detection and automated royalty tracking addresses core operational inefficiencies. This is a bold, high-risk initiative that directly impacts revenue streams and competition.

first_actions: Define MVP scope for AI similarity detection focusing on top 10% infringement risks.
Establish a cross-functional small team (Engineering/Legal) to define data requirements.
Secure 'seed' budget allocation specifically for this pilot project.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual royalty tracking time by 40% and identification of 5 high-priority infringement cases within 6 months
milestones: Initial AI model trained on internal dataset (Month 4)
Full pilot implementation and performance review (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Adjacent Market Opportunity Screening Framework
opportunities.rationale: To meet the board mandate for 25% of revenue from non-existent sources, we need a formalized system to systematically explore adjacent markets. This builds on the strategic priority and prepares the ground for acquisition scouting.

first_actions: Develop a formal scoring matrix based on industry trends (e.g., adjacent media/tech services).
Identify 5 target adjacent sectors suitable for organic build or M&A screening.
Allocate dedicated time for market analysis outside of core production schedules.
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and detailed feasibility report on at least 3 high-potential adjacent business models within Q4

opportunities.title: Marketing Automation Integration with CRM
opportunities.rationale: Building on the successful 18-month CRM deployment, integrating marketing automation and AI lead scoring will improve pipeline efficiency and provide early signals for potential revenue diversification opportunities.

first_actions: Identify integration points between current CRM and available marketing platforms.
Define key metrics (e.g., MQL to SQL conversion rate) for the integrated system.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in qualified lead pipeline by 20% within one fiscal year

next_steps.action: Formalize the 'Innovation Budget' request and defend its necessity based on strategic goals.
Assign a senior engineer to lead the initial scoping phase for OP_01 (AI Royalty Pilot).
Complete the market scoring matrix for adjacent markets as outlined in OP_02.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, protected innovation budget beyond standard infrastructure costs.
Fragmented system integration between existing digital tools (CRM/Marketing).
Stretched talent capacity: Senior engineer time is frequently diverted to urgent production incidents.

improvements: Formalized strategic planning process for senior leadership.
Successfully completed step 3 of previous recommendation set.
Improved team structure by hiring 7 senior leaders.
persistent_gaps: Lack of formalized innovation governance and budget allocation.
Ad-hoc system integration leading to inefficiency.
High operational burden on core teams limiting time for strategic exploration.
achieved_milestones: Deployment of new CRM system (18 months ago).
Transition from founder-led to professional management.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shifted governance structure and formalization of planning processes; increased strategic mandate for diversification. Maturity improved from partial to developing due to professional management transition.
